question: Find the display name and website URL of the user who owns the most valuable post (highest FavoriteCount) that is well-finished (ClosedDate IS NOT NULL), and also calculate the total score of all posts edited by this same user.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_user AS (
    SELECT p."XCL_033" AS user_id
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p."XCL_044" IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY p."XCL_039" DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
total_score AS (
    SELECT SUM(p."XCL_031") AS total_score
    FROM postHistory AS ph
    JOIN posts AS p ON ph."XCL_014" = p."XCL_026"
    WHERE ph."XCL_017" = (SELECT user_id FROM top_user)
)
SELECT u."XCL_055", u."XCL_057", ts.total_score
FROM top_user AS tu
JOIN users AS u ON tu.user_id = u."XCL_052"
CROSS JOIN total_score AS ts
